column1: GENERIC EXPORT — NOT A DTIC SUBMISSION. This workbook is a documented mapping of an OpenSCG guide, produced by an experimental Imprint spike. It has not been checked against any DoD or DTIC template and must not be described as meeting DoDM 5200.45 or any submission format. The OpenSCG JSON file is the authoritative copy; see the loss report for what this workbook does not carry. The digest shown identifies the signed JSON payload; it does not prove this workbook matches it.
